info.name: ASSA Middleware API Test Suite
info.description:
Koleksi Postman resmi untuk pengujian seluruh API ASSA Middleware WSO2 MI Monorepo & Gateway.
Target Endpoint Default: http://localhost:6031
Dapat digunakan bergantian dengan Environment Local / Server Dev.
Mencakup:
- Health & Readiness Probes (12 Endpoint)
- Auth & Scope Security Guards (401/403)
- Input Validation Checks (400)
- Inquiry & Pagination (200 OK)
- Parallel Fan-Out Service Request (10x Retries & MariaDB Audit Logs)
- Background Retry Worker
